title: The Poachers
text: Poachers have trapped the quarry in a netted pit, where it thrashes, bleeding from the stakes. They mean to sell it alive to someone who pays well for such things, though they do not say who. They grin at you over their crossbows.

options.label: Buy the quarry from them, so it is yours to hunt and not theirs to sell.

outcomes.text: The price is fair. Then they cut it loose on you, and the fight is fair too.

options.label: Drive the poachers off; this hunt is yours.

outcomes.text: They fight. In the chaos the quarry tears free and is gone.

options.label: The gentlest frees the beast, whatever it might do once loose.

outcomes.text: It does not attack. It watches you a long moment, then goes, and the way it takes is shorter.
